notes.text:
This update for perl-DBI fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-88815: numeric value incorrectly treated as strings in `sql_type_cast_svpv` allows for process crash
  (bsc#1283055).
- CVE-2026-88816: numeric value incorrectly treated as strings in `FetchHashKeyName` allows for process crash
  (bsc#1283056).
